correctness.rationale: The two exact subset probability laws are derived from the stated algorithms and all pivot denominators are positive under SPD. The Schur complement leaves exactly one diagonal residual det(A)/w_ij. Harmonic-mean equality is exact. The upper optimization uses distances of rank-one Gram projectors, which satisfy triangle inequalities, and a monotone squared-side transfer to a degenerate triangle followed by a nonnegative fully factored rational certificate. Regularized collinear unit-vector Gram matrices give a sharp limit 6/5. The 682 exact assertions in verify.py replayed from the package; finite checks are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: At the first nontrivial rank-two/three-point sampling budget, this classifies exactly which of two practical Nyström pivot-selection laws has lower expected trace risk on all equal-self-similarity kernels and quantifies the maximal 20% shortfall. The lower equality class and nearly collinear sharp family give actionable structural benchmarking. The restriction to a natural matrix class is essential, as a diagonal counterexample reverses dominance when diagonals are unequal. No downstream theorem or computational speed claim is required for the precise natural performance invariant.
